changes: Fixed translation installation preparation when the XiaomiPCManager service has stopped but its MAFSvr.exe process has not yet exited.
Updated the Russian and English translation archives for XiaomiPCManager 6.0.2.19.
Added support for XiaomiPCManager 6.0.2.30 with separate Russian and English translations.
Added the XiaomiPCManager 6.0.2.30 installer (_6.0.2.30_acb3c61c.exe) to the download catalog.

Maintenance status is checked every 10 seconds regardless of its current state. An already running PATCHER detects maintenance activation without restarting; the interface unlocks automatically after expectedEnd, and polling continues.
The refresh button also reloads the maintenance configuration. Requests do not overlap; unchanged background checks should not cause interface flicker or fill the log with repeated messages.

Clarified handling of MiPlayCastService.exe and MiRemoteDeskService.exe during translation installation: services in the selected XiaomiPCManager folder are stopped and restored through the Windows Service Control Manager, with state confirmation.

The unavailable-working-directory warning for user processes no longer applies to services whose launch configuration is managed by the Service Control Manager. Actual stop and restore failures are still recorded in the log.

Updated the Russian and English translation archives for XiaomiPCManager 6.0.2.19. Both packages contain an updated dist/static/js/main.js; each retains the same 1027-file inventory, with sizes and SHA256 values refreshed in the catalogs.
Before installing a translation, PATCHER closes processes from the selected XiaomiPCManager folder and its subfolders instead of relying on a fixed list of executable names.
Service handling has been corrected, including Xiaomi Continuity Service: related services are stopped through the Windows Service Control Manager and awaited so that translation files are released.
After installation, an error or cancellation, only processes and services stopped by PATCHER are restored; user processes retain their launch arguments, working directory and original privileges.
The automatic scan does not affect processes belonging to other XiaomiPCManager installations or programs outside the selected folder; stop and restore errors are recorded in the log.
Fixed the XiaomiPCManager 6.0.2.19 installer download link: the catalog now uses the actual GitHub Release asset name after server-side name normalization, eliminating the 404 error.
Fixed the completed installation-patch layout on the home screen: long descriptions and folder paths no longer overlap action buttons or the activity log.

Checking again after preparing an installation patch no longer reports a preparation failure when XiaomiPCManager is not installed. An absent installation is shown as a normal state with installer-download and patch-preparation actions; the state descriptions have been clarified.
Added support for XiaomiPCManager 6.0.2.19 with separate Russian and English translations.
The translation card now has a language selector; languages unavailable for the selected version are dimmed and cannot be selected. Downloads, preloads and installation use the selected language.
Starting with XiaomiPCManager 6.0.2.19, the camera and theme modules are hidden; installing a preloaded translation no longer offers a transition to the camera patch.
PATCHER interface language settings now offer System default, Russian and English.
Russian and English release history is loaded from GitHub; English history is stored separately in changelog.en.json and is not embedded in the release build.

When XiaomiPCManager is not installed, the home screen offers an installer download and installation-patch preparation. The installer and msimg32.dll are saved to the patch folder beside PATCHER without being launched automatically.
XiaomiPCManager 6.0.2.19 has been added to the installer catalog.
Maintenance is now controlled only by the expectedEnd date: the status is cleared automatically when the deadline passes, and separate yes/no flags are no longer used.
The XiaomiPCManager version card shows a red indicator when an unsupported version is detected.
New interface: bottom navigation, a new font and custom SVG icons.
Checks and updates are now on the home screen: a downloaded PATCHER update is applied with the Restart button, while the user runs the XiaomiPCManager installer manually.
Module selection, installation progress and the result are shown in the main card; the prompt to restart Windows Explorer no longer opens in a separate window.
Progress reporting and remaining-time estimates have been reworked; intensive checks and installation run outside the main UI thread.
Detailed logs are presented as a table with timestamps, events, an entry count, saving and clearing; recent events are shown on the home screen.
Release history is presented as cards; the About page fits the window, and QR codes are larger and have transparent backgrounds.
The "A word from the author" card expands over the interface; the shortened text indicates that more content is available.
Theme and version selectors have been updated with rounded styling and smooth appearance animations; transitions and automatically hiding scrollbars have been improved.
After a successful standard installation, the selected version's temporary cache is deleted: both the downloaded archive and the extracted files.
Translations for XiaomiPCManager 5.8.0.74, 5.8.0.95, 5.8.1.121 and 5.8.1.130 have been updated
After installing the translation or camera patch, PATCHER restarts the programs it closed to replace files.
The executable path, launch arguments and working directory are preserved; components that have already restarted are not duplicated. Programs not closed by PATCHER are not started.
Programs are also restored after an error, installation cancellation or closing PATCHER; relaunch results and errors are recorded in the logs.
Programs using the context-menu file are closed individually without terminating untracked child processes, then restarted with their original user permissions.
Related services are restored through the Windows Service Control Manager; if a safe restart method cannot be determined, the process is not terminated and the reason is recorded in the logs.
Translations for 5.8.0.74, 5.8.0.95, 5.8.1.121 and 5.8.1.130 have been updated.
TouchScreen resources have been added to the image sets for 5.8.0.95, 5.8.1.121 and 5.8.1.130; all four ZIP archives have been verified and their SHA256 hashes recalculated.
Added process termination before translation installation, with executable-path and process-exit verification.
Components in other XiaomiPCManager folders and versions are not affected; EXE relaunch protection remains active during file replacement.
Translations have been updated for 5.8.0.74, 5.8.0.95, 5.8.1.121 and 5.8.1.130.
Normal creation of the touchscreen button has been restored in XiaomiPCManager 5.8.0.95, 5.8.1.121 and 5.8.1.130, fixing the cause of the panel failing to finish loading on supported models.
The contents of all four versions have been checked; the PATCHER 1.0.18 package has been prepared.
Fixed files becoming locked again when a component automatically restarts after being closed.
Programs being replaced are protected against being relaunched, loaded or written to until installation or rollback finishes.
Components are closed again immediately before file locks are acquired; limited retries handle races with automatic restarts.
Protection applies only to files in the selected installation.
The translation has been updated for 5.8.0.74, 5.8.0.95, 5.8.1.121 and 5.8.1.130.
Fixed translation installation.
Components of the selected XiaomiPCManager version are closed again before files are applied; processes with the same names in other folders are not affected.
Installation checks the files to be replaced before making changes and skips byte-for-byte identical files.
The translation and selected icons are installed with backups and rollback on error.
If installation fails, the verified archive and unused preload are retained for another attempt.
Fixed self-update compatibility with version 1.0.12.
The updated program replaces the old version and starts in the original folder, without passing installer switches to PATCHER itself.
Fixed argument forwarding and handling of paths containing spaces, Cyrillic characters and special characters.
PATCHER exits for self-update only after the replacement helper has started successfully.
Version increased to 1.0.14.
The "A word from the author" section has been replaced with a new message from the author.
The 5.8.0.74 translation has been updated.
Added support for XiaomiPCManager 5.8.0.95, 5.8.1.121 and 5.8.1.130.
Translations for 5.8.0.74, 5.8.0.95, 5.8.1.121 and 5.8.1.130 have been synchronized.
Translation quality and coverage have been improved.
A patch is available for the new versions.
The version 5.8.1.130 installer has been added to the download catalog.
Added protection against running multiple instances.
Added preloading of the application update, translation and camera patch for the selected XiaomiPCManager version.
Preloading has no time limit, displays download size and speed, and supports cancellation.
The Installation page shows how many installations are available from the preload.
After a successful installation, the preloaded translation is deleted; on error, it is retained for another attempt. The camera patch can be reused.
Completed preloads are verified and remain available for offline installation after restarting PATCHER.
The Check page now has a button for downloading a newer XiaomiPCManager version, without a new-version popup.
The latest supported version has changed to 5.8.1.130. Installers are published separately.
Version increased to 1.0.12.
Maintenance status is checked again every 10 seconds, and the interface is automatically unlocked when maintenance ends.
Before installation, PATCHER identifies programs that are in use. The user can close them and continue without a partial installation.
Copy errors now include the exact path of the file or folder that could not be replaced.
Version increased to 1.0.11.
Added a controlled maintenance mode that blocks all sections and displays a description and expected completion time.
After the translation is installed successfully, PATCHER offers to restart Windows Explorer to apply translated names and context-menu entries.
Version increased to 1.0.10.
PATCHER starts automatically after an update is installed.
Version displays in information sections now use the shared application version value.
Updated translations have been added to 5.8.0.74.
Added Russian labels for Paste and Connect, file-transfer statuses, incoming-call elements and tablet interaction options.
The Xiaomi Share context-menu entry 使用小米互传发送 has been translated as Send.
Fixed the tablet options Duplicate screen, Extend screen, and Keyboard and mouse.
Version increased to 1.0.9.
Manual update checks now bypass the cache, just like the startup check.
Fixed the case where the startup check found an update but the Check button reported that no update was needed.
The Ready status no longer hides an available update.
Version increased to 1.0.8.
Fixed downloads being interrupted after about 20 seconds.
The download timeout has been set to 5 minutes.
Logs now show detailed network-error information: the HTTP status code and error text.
Fixed changelog loading.
The changelog now supports the new format.
Self-update has been restored to the working approach of installing into the folder of the running PATCHER.
Version increased to 1.0.7.
Added Patches to the Installation section.
The Patches card in the Installation section is now clickable.
Added patch controls for 5.8.0.74.
For other versions, the Patches section displays an In development status.
Updated self-update metadata and the link to the 1.0.7 self-extracting package.
Added a Cancel button to the download and installation dialogs.
Self-update now extracts the new version into the exact folder from which PATCHER was launched.
The user can interrupt translation installation or PATCHER self-update at any time.
On cancellation or error, the window stays open until the user clicks OK.
Long operations trigger a timeout, and the status displays a message about a slow download or interrupted installation.
Added patch files to 5.8.0.74 for blocking and restoring the camera-check notification.
Updated the 5.8.0.74 metadata after adding the patch.
The notification is blocked at the call level, rather than merely translated.
Updated the translation for 5.8.0.74.
Translated popup messages.
Translated part of the Chinese interface using screenshots submitted to the group.
Replaced the support item in About with Chinese characters.
Updated the description, link and QR code.
Fixed installation of translated images.
Requests now bypass the cache.
Fixed the update window finding a new version but displaying an empty changelog.
Added a fallback changelog display when the exact version range does not match.
Renamed List of changes to Changelog.
Added an icon for Changelog in the sidebar.
Removed the Refresh button from the changelog page.
Fixed old corrupted Russian strings in interface elements.
Added the List of changes section.
Release history now loads correctly.
On startup, PATCHER checks for its own updates without checking XiaomiPCManager.
When a new version is found, a window appears with the update version and changelog.
Added Cancel and Install buttons to the update window.
Fixed PATCHER offering an update to the same version.
The version card no longer shows a download button when the versions are equal.
Updated the 5.8.0.74 translation.
Added a detailed logs section.
Logs show versions, links, the selected image set and error details.
PATCHER self-update installs into the folder from which it was launched.
Installing images now replaces the contents with the selected set.
Updated image-set labels and fixed clipped two-line text.
First stable self-extracting release.
Added XiaomiPCManager version detection and downloading from GitHub.
Added a PATCHER version card with support for future self-updates.
Added Russian translation installation and image-set selection.
